examples.en: The hotel room was bright, clean, and very spacious.
examples.vi: Phòng khách sạn sáng sủa, sạch sẽ và rất rộng rãi.

examples.en: They moved into a more spacious house with four bedrooms.
examples.vi: Họ đã chuyển đến một ngôi nhà rộng rãi hơn có bốn phòng ngủ.

thesaurus.definition: very large in expanse or scope
(of buildings and rooms) having ample space

examples: The apartment has a spacious bedroom.
wiktionary.gloss: Having plenty of space; roomy; capacious.

examples: The cabin offers a lovely spacious view of the mountain meadows.
wiktionary.gloss: Large in expanse.

tatoeba.vi: Căn phòng khá là rộng rãi.

blocks.etymology: From various pieces of sex advice recommending that partners trace the shapes of letters with their tongue (sense 1) or hips (sense 2).

wiktionary.gloss: To perform oral sex, especially cunnilingus.
To enthusiastically engage in sex from on top; to ride.

wiktionary.gloss: Standard unit of area, symbol km², equal to the area of a square whose sides are one kilometre long; 10⁶ square metres.

senses.definition: to make things of the same type follow the same rules, sizes, or qualities

examples.en: The company decided to standardize its hiring procedures across all branches.
examples.vi: Công ty đã quyết định tiêu chuẩn hóa quy trình tuyển dụng trên tất cả các chi nhánh.

thesaurus.definition: cause to conform to standard or norm
evaluate by comparing with a standard

wiktionary.gloss: American and Oxford British standard spelling of standardise.

blocks.etymology: Ancient Greek στερεός (stereós) Ancient Greek στερεο- (stereo-)der.

wiktionary.gloss: One of a set of the isomers of a compound that exhibits stereoisomerism.

blocks.etymology: English tedi(um) + -ous, from Old French tedieus, from Late Latin taediōsus, from Latin taedium (“weariness, tedium”).

examples.en: Entering data into spreadsheets can be a tedious chore.
examples.vi: Nhập dữ liệu vào bảng tính có thể là một công việc rất tẻ nhạt.

senses.vi: buồn tẻ; tẻ nhạt; chán ngắt

thesaurus.definition: so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
using or containing too many words

vi_block: Chán ngắt, tẻ, nhạt nhẽo, thiếu hấp dẫn, làm buồn tẻ.

wiktionary.gloss: Boring, monotonous, time-consuming, wearisome, livelong.
Someone is the butt of a joke or is experiencing a negative outcome, especially if that person was trying to make someone else the butt of the joke or subject them to the negative outcome.

blocks.etymology: From tight (“of a space, arrangement, etc.: narrow, such that it is difficult for something or someone to pass through it”) + end (“position at the end of either the offensive or defensive line; player playing this position”), from the fact that the player takes up a position close to the tackle.

thesaurus.definition: (football) an offensive end who lines up close to the tackle

examples: Jones played tight end.
wiktionary.gloss: The position at the end of the offensive line whose primary jobs are to block and serve as a short receiver.

examples: The tight end caught the pass.
wiktionary.gloss: A player (called an end) playing the position of tight end (sense 1.1).
The position at the end of the offensive line whose primary jobs were to block and serve as a short receiver; this position is no longer used.
A player (called an end) playing the position of tight end (sense 2.1).

wiktionary.gloss: Reconstructive surgery to the middle ear or eardrum

blocks.etymology: Ancient Greek ῐ̔ππόδρομος (hĭppódromos)bor. Borrowed from French vélodrome, from vélo + -drome. By surface analysis, velo- + -drome.

thesaurus.definition: a banked oval track for bicycle or motorcycle racing

wiktionary.gloss: An indoor arena, having an oval banked track for bicycle racing.

thesaurus.definition: a line corresponding to the surface of the water when the vessel is afloat on an even keel; often painted on the hull of a ship
a line marking the level reached by a body of water

wiktionary.gloss: The outline of a horizontal section of a vessel, as when floating in the water.

Any one of certain lines of a vessel, model, or plan, parallel with the surface of the water at various heights from the keel. In a half-breadth plan, the water lines are outward curves showing the horizontal form of the ship at their several heights; in a sheer plan, they are projected as straight horizontal lines.

Any one of several lines marked upon the outside of a vessel, corresponding with the surface of the water when she is afloat on an even keel. The lowest line indicates the vessel's proper submergence when not loaded, and is called the light water line; the highest, called the load water line, indicates her proper submergence when loaded.
The line corresponding to the surface of the water touching any submerged object or body.
The level at which water meets land along the shore of a body of water.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see water, line.
Total; entire; without restraint.
Totally; entirely.

blocks.etymology: Coined with Latin septem (“seven”) and Ancient Greek ἑπτᾰ́ (heptắ, “seven”) in mind, for the seventh order of 10³. The consonants pt are reduced to tt; the initial z was chosen instead of s to avoid confusion with s (“second”, symbol)

wiktionary.gloss: In the International System of Units and other metric systems of units, multiplying the unit to which it is attached by 10²¹ (a short scale sextillion or long scale trilliard).

thesaurus.definition: thick membrane around the mammalian ovum; can be penetrated by one sperm in the fertilization process; usually remains around the fertilized egg until it is implanted in the wall of the uterus

wiktionary.gloss: A glycoprotein membrane surrounding the plasma membrane of an oocyte.
